entities.summary: Shakeel Abbasi is a former international field hockey player from Pakistan. He played as a forward, mainly as an inside right or center forward. A skillful forward, Abbasi was regarded as one of the finest players for Pakistan and made over 300 appearances for the national team. He also played for various club sides around the world and was reputed as a world-class player of his era. Shakeel Abbasi was a athletes & competitors from Quetta (b. 1984-01-05, Quetta). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
